const hasUppercase=/[A-Z]/.test(password);const hasLowercase=/[a-z]/.test(password);const hasNumber=/[0-9]/.test(password);const hasSpecial=/[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=[\]{};':"\\|,.<>/?]/.test(password);if(!hasUppercase||!hasLowercase||!hasNumber||!hasSpecial){return{isValid:false,message:'Password must include uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character'};}return{isValid:true,message:''};};/**
